summary_en: This study tests gocatamig, ifinatamab deruxtecan (I-DXd), and durvalumab, given alone or in combination, in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer that has relapsed or stopped responding to prior treatment. All study drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion until disease progression or stopping criteria are met; the exact schedule is not stated. The study looks at safety and how well the drugs are tolerated, and whether the cancer gets smaller or goes away; it is a Phase 1b/2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba gocatamig, ifinatamab deruxtecan (I-DXd) y durvalumab, solos o combinados, en cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa que reapareció o dejó de responder a un tratamiento previo. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV) hasta que la enfermedad progrese o se cumplan los criterios para suspenderlos; el horario exacto no se indica. El estudio evalúa la seguridad y la tolerancia a los medicamentos, y si el cáncer se reduce o desaparece; es un estudio de fase 1b/2.
who_for: Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (stage IV) confirmed by tissue testing
Cancer progressed or stopped responding after at least one prior line of treatment that included platinum-based chemotherapy
Able to provide an archival tumor sample or a fresh biopsy sample
If HIV-positive, HIV must be well controlled on antiretroviral therapy
not_for: Pleural effusion, pericardial effusion, or ascites needing repeated drainage
Any history of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis (with a narrow exception for radiation pneumonitis without steroids)
Active or past immune deficiency, except well-controlled HIV on antiretroviral therapy
Certain heart events or arterial clots within 6 months before the first dose
Untreated or symptomatic brain metastases, or active viral hepatitis
